train_run_finetune: run the VoxCPM model finetuning with pretrained weights, training manifest, and validation manifest
validate_model: validate the VoxCPM model on a validation dataset and generate sample audio for TensorBoard logging
generate_sample_audio: generate sample audio from the VoxCPM model using validation text prompts and log mel spectrograms to TensorBoard
save_checkpoint: save model optimizer scheduler and training state checkpoint with LoRA or full finetune strategies
load_checkpoint: load the latest checkpoint including model weights optimizer state scheduler and resume step number
